description: Demolition of units 1-5 and redevelopment of the site to erect a mixed development of offices and 4 x two-bed terraced dwellings with access road and associated parking
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development of the houses shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the houses hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - No development of the office shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the office hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the buildings are occupied.

Condition : 5 - A scheme of phasing of development shall be submitted to and agreed by the Local Planning Authority before development commences and the development shall be implemented in accordance with that scheme unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0800  to 1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0800 to 1300 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - Before commencement of operations, a scheme shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority to cover the following matters:

(i)	any external illumination of the site during construction

(ii)	measures to ensure that all mud and other loose materials are not carried on the wheels and chassis of any vehicles leaving the site; and

(iii)	measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties.

The scheme so approved should be fully implemented.

Condition : 8 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northwest wall of the houses hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 9 - The waste and recycled materials storage arrangements for the houses shown on the approved drawing shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 10 - The waste and recycled materials storage arrangements for the offices shown on the approved drawing shall be completed before any part of the office accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 11 - No development shall take place until full details of both hard and soft landscape works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.  These details shall include proposed finished levels or contours; means of enclosure; car parking layouts; other vehicle and pedestrian access and circulation areas; hard surfacing material; refuse or other storage units, signs and  lighting.

Soft landscape works shall include planting plans; written specifications, schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate; and implementation programme

Condition : 12 - All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.  The works shall be carried out prior to the occupation of any part of the development or in accordance with the programme agreed with the local planning authority

Condition : 13 - No development shall take place until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority a plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment to be erected.  The boundary treatment shall be completed before the buildings are occupied or in accordance with a timetable agreed in writing with the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 14 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No. 519/RDP/PO1C and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.
Condition : 15 - Development shall not commence until a survey of the existing ground levels has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 16 - The use hereby permitted for offices shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 17 - The use hereby permitted for residential purposes shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the houses against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.
Condition : 18 - The ground levels shall not be raised or otherwise altered from those shown on the submitted plan, without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority
Condition : 19 - No soakaways shall be constructed in contaminated land

Condition : 20 - Before the development hereby permitted commences on the site an investigation shall be carried out to identify the extent of contamination and the results provided to the Local Planning Authority.  The investigation will be carried out at such points and to such depth as the Local Planning Authority may stipulate.  A scheme for decontamination of the site shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Authority in writing and the scheme as approved shall be fully implemented and completed before any development hereby permitted is first occupied.

Condition : 21 - 21.	The development hereby approved shall not commence until details of a scheme of access for construction traffic has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing

Condition : 22 - No part of the office or residential development hereby approved shall be occupied until the 1.5m high barrier shown on drawing no 519/RDP/PO1C is in place, and thereafter means of pedestrian and vehicular access to the houses shall be from New Road only, and the means of vehicular and pedestrian access to the offices shall be from Cross Lances Road only

Condition : 23 - 23.	The existing brick wall on the southwestern boundary of the site, adjacent to 12 New Road shall be retained. If it becomes damaged during construction it shall be re-instated to the same height prior to first occupation of any of the development hereby approved
